description: This file contains service functions for managing articles, including CRUD operations, fetching feeds, comments, and handling favorites in a blog or social media application.

methods.name: buildFindAllQuery
methods.description: Builds a dynamic query array for filtering articles based on author, tag, and favorited status.

methods.name: getArticles
methods.description: Fetches a list of articles based on query filters and pagination.

methods.name: getFeed
methods.description: Retrieves articles from authors followed by the user, with pagination.

methods.name: createArticle
methods.description: Creates a new article with validation, slug generation, and tag association.

methods.name: getArticle
methods.description: Retrieves a single article by its slug, including related data.

methods.name: updateArticle
methods.description: Updates an existing article after authorization and validation.

methods.name: deleteArticle
methods.description: Deletes an article if the user is authorized.

methods.name: getCommentsByArticle
methods.description: Fetches comments for a specific article, including author info and following status.

methods.name: addComment
methods.description: Adds a comment to an article after validation.

methods.name: deleteComment
methods.description: Deletes a comment if the user is authorized.

methods.name: favoriteArticle
methods.description: Marks an article as favorited by the user and returns updated article info.

methods.name: unfavoriteArticle
methods.description: Removes a favorited mark from an article for the user and returns updated info.
